cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Could You Just…
cards.instruction: Turn a difficult task into tiny favors until the help quietly becomes most of the task.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm only passing the tools. Could you hold this shelf bracket against the holes while I choose the right screw?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This top one will hold it. Could you turn it once? I'll keep the rest ready, then you can let go.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's holding. The other screws are already lined up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just tighten those, then? I'll put the shelf beside you; slide it on to check it fits, and I'll fetch your coat.
